title: Miband 4 - Bug Report: Screen Brightness
body:
My Miband shows this bug with the screen brightness. Night mode in xDrip is off , no other apps that accesses the Miband.

The screen goes dark for the watch face upload (as intended) but after that it stays dark for about 20s to 60s. It seems to switch back to day mode when the next full minute is reached.

I use Samsung A40, xDrip 01.09.2020, Mi Smart Band 4 V1.0.9.48

Are there people with the same problem, any idea what this could be @bigdigital?

Is that possible that you had a weak Bluetooth connection when such problem happens? For example, the phone was far from the band or band was under the water? After the watchface uploading, the xdrip has a 7 seconds delay before restoring screen brightness. If your band lose  Bluetooth connection during this time, the brightness wouldn't be restored. In this case the screen brightness would be restored on the next wathface uploading sequence. Regarding the delay, this delay designed to mask watchface uploading process (The band firmware automatically switch on display after the watchface uploading)
Unfortunately I think the connection quality is not the problem. The issue also appears when the devices are directly side by side. Is Xdrip writing some log files that could help you troubleshoot?

Could you please try to install the following test  application and let me know if it would work better for you
https://www.dropbox.com/s/ku44dkv42o5x4ji/xdrip_miband_0.3.1.3_test.apk?dl=0

Here I also modified a feedback recipient address to my private server. So the log reports would be sent directly to me. To send xdrip logs, you would need to click to the "upload logs'  button which is located in the events logs interface.

If this problem occurs, please send me a xdrip logs by using vents logs interface.  For this, please make sure you have added “MibandService:d” (without quotes) in xdrip Settings->Less common settings-> Extra logging -> Extra tags for loggings . After this go to “Less common settings” -> View recent error interface. Leave enabled only “Low” and "High" checkboxes And click to "upload logs" button. If possible, in the feedback description text specify the approximate time when this error happens. Thanks.

Hi bigdigital,
I found something. My observation is that it happens when the phone screen is off. I followed your instruction and uploaded the log.

It is OK when:
- The phone is on the charger
- The screen is on and xDrip is in the foreground
- The screen is on and another app is in the foreground
- The high or low glucose alarm triggers (screen off, but the alarm sounding)

It looks like during the 7-second wait xDrip is send to sleep and needs about 1 minute to wake back up. I have all battery optimization off  as far as possible. Global "Energy Mode=optimized" (best performance), xDrip "Background Activity=allowed", xDrip "Energy Usage=not optimized". When I wake up the phone it seems that the watch screen changes to normal in about a second.

Can you use an alternative method to implement the 7 second delay? In case it uses more battery then only as a workaround option for those that have this problem.
Indeed, seems that your phone can't "wakeup" in time after the thread was sent to sleep.  I'll try to implement this delay in another way and share a test application again.
